summary: Detects the Windows OS version via GetVersionExA (156-byte OSVERSIONINFOA, retrying with 148 bytes) and selects a platform-name string into a local buffer: Win32s, Windows 9x family (95/98/Me by major/minor), or Windows NT family (NT, 2000, XP by major/minor). On success the selected string is copied into the output argument a1 when non-null and its length returned. Called by ConfigIniParser (00421CD0).

operations.description: Copy the default platform string aUnknown into the local v13 buffer via a do-while loop terminated on the null terminator.
Zero the OSVERSIONINFOA structure with memset, then set dwOSVersionInfoSize (first dword) to 156.
Call GetVersionExA with the 156-byte structure; on failure retry after setting dwOSVersionInfoSize to 148.
If both GetVersionExA attempts fail, skip all string selection and return the failed result (0).
If dwPlatformId (offset +16) is 0 (Win32s), copy byte_5C3044 into v13 and jump to the copy-out path.

If dwPlatformId (offset +16) is 1 (Win32 Windows 9x): with dwMajorVersion (offset +4) >= 4 and dwMinorVersion (offset +8) >= 0x5A copy byte_5C3070 (Me); else if major > 4 or minor != 0 copy byte_5C3058 (98); else copy byte_5C3064 (95).

If dwPlatformId (offset +16) is 2 (Win32 NT): with dwMajorVersion (offset +4) <= 4 copy aWindowsNt; otherwise with major >= 5 copy aWindowsXp when dwMinorVersion (offset +8) is non-zero, else aWindows2000.
Copy-out path: when output argument a1 is non-null, strcpy(a1, v13) writes the selected platform string to the caller's buffer.
Return the string-length result (loop index of the last copied string), or the leftover value for platforms outside the handled range. ConfigIniParser (00421CD0) is the caller.
